description: This file defines a logging utility class `Log` that provides static methods for logging messages at various priority levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper around Android's native `Log` class and manages a chain of `LogNode` objects for extended logging behavior.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static logging methods, acting as a wrapper around Android's native log functions and managing a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current top LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards a log message to the current LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
